name: How can I maximize storage in a small kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize storage in a small kitchen remodel, consider incorporating several clever solutions. Utilize vertical space with tall pantry cabinets or stacked upper cabinets. Install pull-out shelving, corner carousels (lazy Susans), and drawer organizers to make items more accessible. Integrated spice racks, knife drawers, and toe-kick drawers can add hidden storage. Also, consider open shelving to display frequently used items and reduce visual bulk, and explore appliance garages to keep countertops clear. Thoughtful design makes a significant difference.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small kitchen storage with tall cabinets, pull-outs, corner carousels, drawer organizers, and toe-kick drawers. Consider open shelving and appliance garages for efficiency.
